acceptance_criteria: cargo test -- sieve_environment_e2e; all 4 scenarios pass
description:
Integration test: DKIM-passing mail filed into Verified folder by Sieve environment test.

File: crates/smtp/tests/ or crates/sieve-native/tests/

Test scenarios:
1. dkim_pass_fileinto_verified:
   - Sieve script: require ["fileinto","environment"]; if environment "vnd.stoa.dkim-result" "pass" { fileinto "Verified"; }
   - SieveEnv: vnd.stoa.dkim-result = "pass"
   - Assert: outcome is FileInto("Verified")

2. spf_fail_fileinto_spam:
   - Script tests vnd.stoa.spf-result against ["fail", "softfail"]
   - SieveEnv: spf-result = "softfail"
   - Assert: outcome is FileInto("Spam")

3. dmarc_reject_policy_discard:
   - Script tests vnd.stoa.dmarc-policy "reject"
   - Assert: outcome triggers reject action

4. no_dkim_defaults_to_none:
   - Empty SieveEnv (no auth results set)
   - Script tests vnd.stoa.dkim-result "none"
   - Assert: matches correctly (unknown name → empty string; "none" set explicitly)

Oracle: known SieveEnv inputs → known expected outcomes.
These are unit-level tests on evaluate(); no real SMTP session needed.
title: E2E test: Sieve environment vnd.stoa.* routes mail by auth result
